biggest_catch: Poshmark charges the highest flat commission of any major marketplace (20%) — under $15 the flat $2.95 fee is even worse proportionally.
catches: For sales under $15, Poshmark takes a flat commission of $2.95 — you keep the rest.
For sales of $15 or more, you keep 80% and Poshmark takes a 20% commission.
As of October 1, 2025, sellers located in Texas see an additional Texas Seller Fee Tax deducted from earnings.
The fee structure is simple and transparent per the official page; listing is free and there is no separate payment processing fee — the commission covers it.

Earnings release: buyers have 3 days from delivery to accept; if they don't accept, Poshmark automatically releases funds on the 4th day after delivery (per official Canadian support page — check the US page for current wording).

For sales of $15 or more, you keep 80% of the sale, and Poshmark takes a 20% commission.' Texas Seller Fee Tax from Oct 1, 2025.

maximize: Never sell sub-$15 single items on Poshmark — the $2.95 flat fee eats 20-59% of cheap sales. Bundle cheap items into $15+ lots to stay on the 20% tier. Price with the 20% baked in: list at target net x 1.25. Because Poshmark is the most expensive platform here, only list here if the audience (fashion buyers) justifies it — cross-list the same items on Depop (0% fee) and Mercari (10%) where the identical sale nets you more. Share listings regularly; stale closets don't sell.

steps: List the item with photos, title, description, and price (free)
Share listings to your followers regularly for visibility
Receive a sale — ship the item to the buyer
Buyer accepts the purchase (or funds release automatically on the 4th day after delivery)
timing: Funds released after buyer acceptance or 4th day post-delivery
who_pays: The buyer pays through Poshmark, and Poshmark releases your earnings after the buyer accepts the item.
who_qualifies: US and Canada sellers; listing is free.
work_available: Poshmark is active and open to new sellers.
what_gets_accepted: Legal, accurately described items are accepted; funds release after the buyer accepts the item (or automatically on the 4th day after delivery if they don't respond).
